bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
if ! output="$(python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py profile_topics_readback 2>&1)"; then
 printf 'PR47_USERBOT_PROFILE_TOPIC_READBACK=FAIL\nCLIENT_OUTPUT=%s\nSERVICE_ACTIVE_AFTER=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$output" | tail -c 600)" "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
 exit 71
fi
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
{ printf 'PR47_USERBOT_PROFILE_TOPIC_READBACK=PASS\n'; printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -E '^(USERBOT_TEST_RESULT|USERBOT_TEST_ACTION|USERBOT_PROFILE_TOPICS)='; printf 'SERVICE_ACTIVE_AFTER=active\n'; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
